pm_enabled.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

vault_has_l1_position.meaning: The Vault holds a hedge or spot position on L1

auto_borrow_occurred.meaning: An adverse price movement triggered a PM auto-borrow on the Vault's L1 account producing a nonzero 0x811 borrow.value

principal_pool_balance_before.meaning: USDC principal pool balance backing USDM before settle transfers

principal_pool_balance_after.meaning: USDC principal pool balance backing USDM after settle transfers

settle_transfer_amount.meaning: USDC amount transferred out of the principal pool to YieldEscrow and onward to sUSDM stakers, InsuranceFund and Foundation by vault.settle

assumptions: The auto-borrow trigger is conditional (potential) in the report; the plan formalizes the scenario in which it occurs.
The exact borrow amount and proposedYield are symbolic; no concrete values are required.
Whether the keeper is buggy or rational is not established and is not assumed.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the true distributable surplus or the annualized Gate 4 cap, so the yield-cap relation (settle must reject proposedYield above true surplus) cannot be given a numeric definition; the conservation relation is stated at the principal-pool amount level instead.

limitations: The conservation relation is expressed over the principal pool balance before/after settle; the report's 'permanently displaced' qualifier and the onward distribution to stakers, InsuranceFund and Foundation are not separately encoded.
The report establishes the auto-borrow only as a potential trigger, so the claim is scoped to that scenario.
